payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the NCEL approach is effective, outperforming baseline methods and achieving better performance metrics.

claims.text: NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability across different datasets.
In experiments, NCEL shows significant improvements over local and global models, particularly in challenging datasets.
